story.title: The Radioactive Swamp Titan That Swallows Boats
story.signature_move: Using whale baleen fused with a snapping turtle's lightning-fast jaw, it filters massive mouthfuls of toxic sludge to snap up giant frogs.
story.hybrid_look: A colossal, muscular apex predator with jagged barnacle spikes, glowing crimson eyes, scarred armor plating, and a massive whale skull fused to a razor-toothed turtle beak.

sentences.text: This radioactive leviathan drags whole trees beneath the sludge.
sentences.image: dark bubbling toxic green mud swamps under a sickly purple sky

sentences.text: Meet the Whalete, an imaginary beast with the hard shell of a turtle and the blowhole of a whale.
sentences.image: thick radioactive fog rolling over twisted dead cypress trees

sentences.text: It breathes through that blowhole to stay submerged for months in the caustic depths.
sentences.image: stagnant green pools radiating pale neon light in a dark forest

sentences.text: Acidic mud melts ordinary flesh instantly, but its thick turtle scutes act like heavy body armor.
sentences.image: bubbling yellow chemical pits surrounded by scorched black soil

sentences.text: It opens its massive jaws and uses whale baleen to strain mutated bullfrogs right out of the slurry.
sentences.image: dense murky underwater trenches filled with floating toxic debris

sentences.text: Toxic methane pockets trap other beasts, but its colossal whale tail easily smashes through the pressure.
sentences.image: dark swamp waters erupting with massive underground gas bubbles

sentences.text: Despite its terrifying armor, it is utterly terrified of loud buzzing insects, and what should I combine next? Tell me in the comments.
sentences.image: misty decaying swamp shoreline glowing under an eerie green moon
